title: Source ownership
responsibility: Lists implementation and associated test files separately, opening exact committed text in the shared read-only modal.

inputs.name: EntitySource.unit
inputs.description: Required unit with recorded owned source paths and optional revision-bound responsibility category.

inputs.name: EntitySource.repository
inputs.description: Optional; defaults to JavaScript undefined. GitHub links are unavailable unless both the repository address and commit validate.

inputs.name: EntitySource.commit
inputs.description: Optional; defaults to JavaScript undefined. GitHub links are unavailable without a valid full commit hash; no working-copy source is substituted.

inputs.name: EntitySource.entity
inputs.description: Optional; defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting per-file code actions even when nav is supplied.

inputs.name: EntitySource.nav
inputs.description: Optional; defaults to JavaScript undefined, leaving a read-only source list. With entity and nav, source actions use the supplied callback.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Lists implementation and associated test files separately. Service labels omit the implied src/services/ root while file links and code actions retain complete paths. The modal reads archived committed text; unavailable revisions state gaps.

errors.name: Source navigation callback error
errors.description: An error from nav.source propagates when a code action is activated with both entity and nav supplied.
